answer.rationale: p99 latency 5x target confined to primary region during settlement peak suggests regional degradation rather than global issue. memory_b2 demonstrates regional failover restored latency within minutes during similar conditions. Rollback is risky during settlement peak (memory_b1 showed success but on lighter traffic); failover is lower-risk because it keeps the prior build running and can be reversed quickly. Verifying memory_b1 and memory_b2 to confirm rollback timing safety and failover speed under peak load. Regional failover preserves all writes, maintains the current release for other regions, and gives us observability into whether the problem is infrastructure or code.
